item.title: Governor declares State of Preparedness ahead of winter storm
item.description: Governor Wes Moore declares a State of Preparedness ahead of a potentially hazardous winter weather system that is expected to bring heavy snow across area.

item.title: Baltimore City to activate emergency operating center Sunday afternoon ahead of winter storm
item.description: Baltimore City Mayor Brandon Scott announced the city will activate the Emergency Operations Center starting at 2:00 p.m Sunday, ahead of a winter storm.
